assessments.topic: Actual native records and common Hamiltonian
assessments.rationale: The stored GPW ULM atoms/results/parameters were read directly, without instantiating GPAW or running a calculator. All 12 raw force banks, extrapolated energies, electronic free energies and geometries agree with their primitives/trajectories. Actual parameters are PBE, PW300 eV, Pd10/H1 PAW, gamma-centred k333, spin-polarized, neutral charge0 and Fermi-Dirac width0.1 eV. Every coordinate is mobile, D mass is2.01410177812 u, and the largest raw all-atom fmax is0.04869914493494736 eV/A, below0.05. All three native execution declarations and producer/setup byte bindings match.

assessments.topic: Independent O/T selection and matched block binding
assessments.rationale: Selection compares extrapolated energies at each N, rather than carrying one winning family through all occupancies: D1axis,D2tetra,D4axis,D6axis. The bulk interstitial insertion is E(bulk8-D1)-E(bulk8)=-3.455799610326018 eV. Positive B is this insertion minus the vacancy insertion per added D. Source energies reproduce all four reported blocks exactly, with D2-to-D4 and D4-to-D6 explicitly block means. Pd and neutral-D references cancel in the matched transfers; neither half-D2 nor an unmatched charged atomic reference is introduced.

The producer saves ASE get_potential_energy() separately from force_consistent=True. GPAW new-calculation energy is total_extrapolated, whereas free_energy is total_free; the binding selector consistently consumes bank.energy_eV, not the separate smearing free energy. Width0.1 eV is the electronic occupation convention and is not an ionic301 K free energy. No physical ZPE or vibrational free-energy calculation is claimed.

assessments.topic: Density units, full-AE integral and midpoint grid targets
assessments.rationale: GPAW reconstructed densities are spin summed in electrons/A^3. For all seven saved cases the full-AE integral agrees with sum of nuclear charges to relative2.40e-7 or better at both24^3 and48^3 grids, satisfying the1e-6 charge target. The saved fine-grid midpoint values and both reported grid-change measures satisfy the declared5 percent target; the largest is0.03679397399247709. Periodic interpolation uses the full skew-cell inverse and node-centred wrapping. D1 has no distinct intracluster pair and no midpoint, not a periodic self-image pair. PAW-valence, not full core density, feeds TF; valence integral residuals remain exposed and are not misrepresented as exact charge conservation.

assessments.topic: Capacity language and primary PBE comparison
assessments.rationale: The axis-only B2-to4 is+0.02732602580698007 eV/D, while selected lowest O/T B2-to4 is-0.014379834208964937 eV/D and B4-to6 is-0.2753018133291967 eV/D. Thus the lowest enumerated excess energy is at N2; the axis plateau around4 is not an established global or finite-T capacity. The report gives both results, explicitly denies proved capacity, and retains mtrap6 as an unqualified phenomenological default rather than setting it to4. Primary arXiv1506.00302 reports a larger108-site PBE calculation with tetrahedral occupancy through8; it independently precludes treating the present sparse single-cell axis result as universal4D capacity.

assessments.topic: Canonical spectator and TF formulas, signs and reference cancellation
assessments.rationale: For the frozen positive spectator, initial C/R becomes2C/R at coalescence, increasing the barrier by C/R. The additional screening change relative to the matched reference is therefore C(1/R_ref-1/R): a closer positive spectator has a negative shift. The canonical TF function implements kF=(3*pi^2*n)^(1/3), kTF=sqrt(4*kF/(pi*a0)) and U=C*kTF, consistent with the theoretical PoS028/044 uniform-electron expression, not its empirical250 eV rescaling. TF returns U(n)-U(n_ref). The beam adapter applies one alternative at a time relative to the actual isovolume Pd8D8 density/geometry, with no second absolute baseline. Molecular Hamiltonian Eqs.4-6 support the Coulomb bookkeeping, not a solved frozen-distance three-body trajectory.

limitations.topic: Single cell size and finite enumerated basin set
limitations.rationale: All scientific vacancy results have8 host sites and fixed volume. The force/stationarity target is met, but that is not a cell-size, basis, kmesh, magnetic/global-minimum or configuration-search convergence theorem. Near-zero electronic increments are observations at the declared protocol, not precision-qualified global thresholds.

D3,D5,D8, configurational degeneracies, hydride-background chemistry and ionic free energies are absent. Selected O/T excess-energy minimum is N2, not evidence of capacity2 either. Primary PBE literature supports competing tetrahedral high occupancies in a different larger cell. Axis plateau language is acceptable only with its existing restriction. Retain mtrap6 as unqualified; do not silently replace it by4.

limitations.topic: Electronic energies do not include D nuclear free energies
limitations.rationale: Deuterium is a neutral H electronic species with the correct classical isotope mass; no nuclear ZPE, quantum distribution or vibrational/configurational entropy is obtained from that mass. The smearing width0.1 eV and extrapolated electronic energies are not an ionic finite-temperature free energy. The per-block source map explicitly assumes zero omitted differential ionic free energy.

limitations.topic: Reservoir mapping and equilibrium curves are diagnostics
limitations.rationale: The source mu0 gauge is handled correctly, but dilute matched bulk-interstitial B_el need not be the free binding of a vacancy in the highly loaded actual PdD environment. Independent block substitutions are not a grand-canonical site partition or a kinetic transport refit. Frozen actual7200 s v is not re-equilibrated and actual xt is not replaced; retained Eb0.23/mtrap6 are not newly physically qualified.

Full-AE integral closure is a charge/units diagnostic, not proof of the local midpoint or valence susceptibility. GPAW adds missing reconstruction charge to nearest atomic grid points only when skip_core=False; skip_core=True is not forced to an exact total integral. Recorded fine-valence integral residuals range6.501813086702969e-5 to0.011331773149712157. Midpoint two-grid changes pass5 percent but are not an independent fine-grid/error theorem. The report exposes these readouts and only uses them as a local proxy.

limitations.topic: Local PAW-valence is not measured conduction response
limitations.rationale: The canonical formula is the theoretical uniform unpolarized free-electron TF closure. PAW-valence includes localized Pd valence character; an actual midpoint n does not determine the nonlocal susceptibility, core polarization, band response or collision dynamics. PoS028/044 distinguishes valence/core dielectric terms and empirical enhancements. The report correctly does not apply the empirical250 eV coefficient or claim first-principles keV screening.

limitations.topic: Frozen positive spectator is a leading-contact sensitivity
limitations.rationale: The correct Coulomb sign/reference subtraction does not solve nuclear motion, angle-dependent energy exchange, electronic rearrangement or a three-body trajectory. The primary molecular Hamiltonian includes all of these degrees of freedom. One representative nearest-pair distance does not certify every collision environment.

limitations.topic: 100 percent pairing is assumed rather than computed
limitations.rationale: The changed target applies one selected pair-environment shift to every transported D, including slab/adsorbate/neutral reactions. This is the expressly stated100-percent-pairing sensitivity, not a simulated pair fraction, distribution or physically proven enhancement bound. The spectator and TF branches are alternatives, not additive microscopic contributions.

Target/compare retain the original fitted causes, stopping model, molecular charge beam, adsorbate and material profiles. Effective Eq7 Ue and the three current re-readings describe that inherited measurement/cause fit, not the tiny computed additional shift. Fit quality and charge assumptions are inherited baseline qualifications, not new defects introduced by the pair adapter.

The252 evaluated rows do not reach10x, but no arbitrary pair configurations, new physical dielectric/ionic mechanism, altered transport or physically measured pair fraction were evaluated. Do not extrapolate this finite list into a universal no-go or physical exclusion.

limitations.topic: Conditional ionic closure remains physically unqualified
limitations.rationale: Reuse of the prior complete accepted review does not establish atomic-wavevector/strong-field/hopping/inertial applicability. The five energy scan uses one frozen2.5-keV-CM material state, not five new profiles or a slowing trajectory. Oxide room-temperature mobility and H-to-D transfer remain unavailable, and the below100 eV gate is an allocation result, not exclusion of all ionic mechanisms.
